_comment: Stream trigger for flow 11 referral-decide. POST this body to /trigger/stream.
flow 11 is INERT without it: the flow itself carries only a manual trigger node.
subject MUST be precomputed as ms.trigger.config.<collection>.<fnv1a32(name)>; the
service does not derive it from the body and an unset subject is 'invalid subject'.
The pair created is an EXPORT of ms.workspaces.task.* and an IMPORT of it back as
hub.trigger.<published flow subject>.*, which hub truncates to six segments to find
the flow. Re-point it after a republish only if the flow's published subject changes;
publishing the same flow does not.
Verified live in antipodean_build 2026-09-02: subject ms.trigger.config.antipodean.3250134652.
name: referral-decide-task-status
description: Flow 11 referral-decide. Every task write in the account publishes to ms.workspaces.task.<taskID> on microstrate-workspaces; this pair exports that subject and imports it as hub.trigger.<flow subject>.* so hub dispatches a run. The body is the partial UpdateTaskRequest, not the task.
subject: ms.trigger.config.antipodean.3250134652
